title_sq: APARTAMENT 1+1 PER SHITJE TE MYSLYM SHYRI
description_sq:
Ne zonen e Myslym Shyrit prane qendres te hotel Favorita ofrohet apartament 1+1 per shitje.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 4 te nje ndertimi relativisht te ri te vitit 2000 me ashensor.
Sip. totale e apartamentit eshte 35.38 m2.
Prona eshte e investuar dhe e pershtatshme per investim.
Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Fotot e prezantuara jane rendera te apartamentit te punuara me arkitekt.
title_en: 1+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE IN MYSLYM SHYRI
description_en: A 1+1 apartment is offered for sale in the area of ​​Myslym Shyr, near the center of the Favorita hotel. The apartment is located on the 4th floor of a relatively new building from the year 2000 with an elevator. Sip. the total of the apartment is 35.38 m2. The property is invested and suitable for investment. Has regular mortgage documentation. The photos presented are renderings of the apartment made by an architect.
